## Validation disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Uses the candidate’s default qty=28 (requires $25K+ account; $1K paper ≈14% headline).
2. **Sample bias:** Full 2025‑01‑02..2026‑06‑18 window (≈410 trading days); selection is all signals generated by the candidate’s trigger; overfit risk mitigated by walk‑forward sub‑window checks.
3. **Out‑of‑sample:** Will compute walk‑forward held‑out (first 80% train, last 20% test) and report ratio; currently NEEDS-OOS.
4. **Real‑fills:** Will run realistic OPRA replay (cached bid/ask, slippage) across the full window; currently NEEDS‑REAL‑FILLS.
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day (max single‑day loss), max drawdown, blow‑up scenario (e.g., gap through stop). To be filled after backtest.
6. **Concentration:** Will compute top‑5‑days % of P&L; currently unknown.
